title: Quick Roasted Australian Beef Roast
description: A date-night Australian dish featuring mixed beef cuts roasted to perfection in a papillote, perfect for a plant-based friendly meal with some adjustments

ingredients.name: Beef roast mix
ingredients.notes: including ribeye, sirloin, and tenderloin cuts

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Rub the mixture all over the beef roast mix, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the sliced onion, carrots, and potatoes in the center of the parchment paper sheet.
Place the beef roast mix on top of the vegetables.
Fold the parchment paper over the beef and vegetables, creating a papillote.
Place the papillote in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast for 45 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
